narrative.details:
adventurer, run and find Advisor Belgrum as quickly as you can. Tell him what you've witnessed and ask him how he wants us to proceed. This note will explain more to him.

In the meantime, I will take the time to speak to Hammertoe's spirit. Maybe he knows something that will help us put a stop to those Shadowforge cretins' activities in the Badlands. We can only pray.
narrative.objectives: Find Advisor Belgrum and give him his note.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, word from Historian Karnik. Excellent.

I always have time for his business.

<Advisor Belgrum opens the note and begins to read.>

quests.objectiveText: Find Hammertoe's Amulet and return it to him in Uldaman.

quests.name: Prospect of Faith
quests.objectiveText: Take Hammertoe's Amulet to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

quests.objectiveText: Kill Ambassador Infernus in Angor Fortress and bring proof of his death to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Will
quests.objectiveText: Find the Tablet of Will, and return them to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
